title: [RODEN] Starred Reviews, New Pop-up, We've Always Been Idiots
content:
Roden Readers —
Hello from the train! I’m en route — once again — to KII PENINSULA which many of you know is where my book Things Become Other Things takes place. I’m going back to photograph PEOPLE. That’s the aim, anyway. We’ll see if I pull it off. You can follow along in real-ish time on my new pop-up: About a Nightingale. It starts today (Feb 23, and ends on March 4, and then I delete all your email addresses).
